import functools
import operator

lul = input().split()

lul = [int(i) for i in lul]

lul.sort(reverse = True)

lent = lul.__len__()

for i in range(lent):
  if i < lent-1 and lul[i] == lul [i+1]:
    if i < lent-2 and lul[i+1] == lul [i+2]:
      lul.remove(lul[i+2])
    lul.remove(lul[i+1])
    lul.remove(lul[i])
    break

print(functools.reduce(operator.add,lul))
